decisions.reason: The passenger check-in app sits at the edge of the firm's security core, and COVID left little airline uptake to learn from, but the firm's in-house technology team and its airport client base give enough related knowledge to keep developing it as aviation recovers in 2022.
PassBoard is a branded product line that builds directly on the firm's know-how in passenger screening and document checks, so the firm can read its results and refine it as airport traffic returns.

Self-service check-in relates to the firm's passenger-processing expertise and touchless processing has become more relevant after the pandemic, though weak evidence of results since 2019 puts it at moderate risk of being folded into other offerings.
